subject: Quantify POC — prompt sample provenance and ingest plan
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@quantify.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@quantify.ai>
Date: 2028-08-09T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Quantify POC — prompt sample provenance and ingest plan

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and a set of asks so we can move the POC forward to data handoff.

Call recap (key points):
- Goal: validate Redwood inference on our conversational support logs and a small generative assistant prompt set; focus on accuracy and hallucination controls.
- We will provide a mixed set: 2k user queries (anonymized), 800 agent replies, and 200 templated prompts for the assistant evaluation.
- Success signals we care about: intent-classification recall, answer factuality (domain-specific), and 95th percentile latency under 250ms at 1rps/instance.

Immediate asks / clarifications:
1) Preferred file format and sample schema for ingest (CSV vs JSONL) — we attached an initial sample (sample_prompts.csv).
2) Provenance metadata: we can include conversation id, timestamp, source channel, and redaction flags — confirm which fields Redwood needs.
3) PII handling: we plan to run a light redaction pass but want to know Redwood's recommended masking fields and if additional on-ingest redaction is available.
4) Upload mechanism: do you prefer S3 presigned, SFTP, or a secure Drive share?
5) Timeline: can we aim to drop the initial 2k/1k sample bundle within 48–72 hours after we get the ingest schema?

Next steps from Quantify: attach sample CSV + a short doc on our internal anonymization process (qa_requirements.md).

Attachments: --Attachment: sample_prompts.csv (CSV, ~18KB)--; --Attachment: qa_requirements.md (MD, ~6KB)--

Thanks — Sam
Sam Patel | Head of ML Eng | Quantify.AI
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0191

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@quantify.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-09T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quantify POC — prompt sample provenance and ingest plan

Sam — really helpful summary, thanks. Looping in Ben and Grace as owners for ingestion and evaluation respectively.

Quick answers and proposed approach:
- File format: JSONL preferred for preserving structured metadata (one event per line). CSV is ok for the first bundle; we can accept sample_prompts.csv and convert, but please include a header row with field names.
- Required provenance fields: conversation_id, message_id, timestamp_iso, channel (web/email/chat), sender_role (user/agent), redacted Boolean. Optional but helpful: original_language, intent_tag (if you have it).
- PII and redaction: your light pass is perfect. On our side we'll run an additional PII scanner to catch any residual tokens. Please mark rows you intentionally left unmasked with redaction_reason.
- Upload: S3 presigned is quickest for many customers; SFTP is available if your security team prefers. We will send a presigned bucket path if you confirm S3.
- Timeline: 48 hours for an initial sample is feasible. We'll prioritize ingest and run an initial pass within 24 business hours of the sample arriving.

Proposed success criteria (draft):
1) Evaluation completeness: >=98% of rows successfully ingested and schema-complete.
2) Relevance/quality: sample must contain at least 1,500 unique user queries (for classification/eval balance).
3) Model quality targets: intent recall >= 0.88 (micro), factuality check false-positive rate <= 6% on curated set.
4) Latency: 95th percentile token latency <= 250ms at target throughput for the selected model/config.

Ownership & next milestones: 
- Priya (you can reach me at this alias) — POC program lead, responsible for success criteria and timeline coordination.
- Ben Carter — ingestion and security liaison (will send upload details).
- Grace O'Connor — evaluation metrics and rubric, will draft an eval template and baseline scripts.

Action items for Quantify: send the first bundle (CSV or JSONL) + a short note on the redaction rules used. We will reply with a presigned S3 path by EOD if S3 is ok.

--
Priya Natarajan
Product - Trials & Integrations | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@quantify.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-09T14:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quantify POC — prompt sample provenance and ingest plan

Sam — quick technical note from the ingestion side.

If you send CSV: please include a UTF-8 BOM if any non-ASCII characters are expected, and ensure timestamps are RFC3339/ISO8601. For JSONL, use newline-delimited JSON with keys exactly as Priya listed; mismatch slows principal ingestion.

We support these upload options (in priority order):
1) S3 presigned upload into a temporary ingestion bucket (recommended)
2) SFTP (we provide a dropbox credential)
3) Encrypted Drive share (for extremely small bundles)

Security point: if your team needs a data processing addendum or specific retention window, flag now — default trial retention is 30 days from ingest unless otherwise negotiated.

I'll prepare the presigned path and a minimal schema file (ingest_schema.json) and drop both into a private drive link if you confirm S3. Grace — once we have the sample I suggest we run a skim ingestion and return an ingestion report (metrics: rows accepted, rows rejected, top schema errors).

--Attachment: ingest_schema.json (JSON, 3KB)--

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@quantify.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@quantify.ai>
Date: 2028-08-11T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quantify POC — prompt sample provenance and ingest plan

Appreciate the clarity — we will proceed with S3 presigned. Confirming next steps from our side:
- I will deliver a first bundle (CSV) containing 2,000 user queries + 800 agent responses and metadata fields we discussed. File will be named quantify_initial_bundle_08011.csv.
- We will include a provenance column called original_source and a redaction_reason column where applicable.
- Security contact: copying our security lead Aisha Khan; she will send the SOC2 summary and a short data processing note.

Request: please send the presigned URL and the ingest_schema.json to this thread. If you can also share the evaluation rubric skeleton (even a simple checklist) that would help our engineers understand upfront what will be measured.

Looking forward to the quick handoff — aiming to drop files within 48 hours.

Best,
Sam
